custody_model: Permissionless non-custodial smart-contract lending markets in which users supply supported assets and may use supplied collateral to borrow other supported assets.
yield_source: Borrower interest paid through overcollateralized DeFi lending markets, with rates determined by market utilization and protocol parameters.
risk_notes: Smart-contract, oracle and collateral-market risks can create severe loss events. The 2021-10-27 exploit specifically affected Ethereum V1 markets; current and other historical market deployments must not be treated as identical to that affected deployment.
